name_en: Tofu dengaku — firm tofu skewered and grilled over charcoal with garlic miso
summary_ja: 硬めに仕立てた木綿豆腐を串に刺し炭火であぶって、にんにく味噌をつけて食べる。豆腐消費量の多い岩手県北で手作り豆腐文化とともに育ち、季節ごとにふきのとうや山椒を効かせた味噌も使われる。
summary_en: Firm cotton tofu is skewered and grilled over charcoal, then dipped in garlic miso — grown out of northern Iwate's homemade-tofu culture in a prefecture with high tofu consumption, its miso seasoned seasonally with butterbur sprout or sansho.
